title: Reverse Neighbor Sliding and Order Selection for Efficient Multi-Proximity Graph Merging
abstract: arXiv:2602.17099v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Approximate k Nearest Neighbor (AKNN) search in high-dimensional space is a foundational problem in vector databases with widespread applications. Among the numerous AKNN indexes, Proximity Graph-based indexes achieve state-of-the-art search efficiency across various benchmarks. In many real-world scenarios, datasets are maintained as multiple segment-level graph indexes to support continuous writes and segment management. However, these fragmented indexes complicate maintenance and degrade search efficiency, making fast graph index merging essential. In this paper, we focus on the efficient merging of multiple existing graph indexes into a single one. To achieve this, we propose a Reverse Neighbor Sliding Merge (RNSM) that exploits structural information to boost merging efficiency. We further propose Merge Order Selection (MOS) to minimize total merge cost across multiple indexes by eliminating redundant operations. Experimen

translated_title: 反向邻居滑动与顺序选择：实现高效的多邻近图合并
translated_abstract: 高维空间中的近似k近邻（AKNN）搜索是向量数据库中的一个基础性问题，应用广泛。在众多AKNN索引中，基于邻近图的索引在各类基准测试中实现了最先进的搜索效率。在许多实际场景中，数据集以多个分段级图索引的形式维护，以支持持续写入和分段管理。然而，这些碎片化的索引使维护变得复杂，并降低了搜索效率，因此快速合并图索引变得至关重要。本文专注于将多个现有图索引高效地合并为单一索引。为此，我们提出了反向邻居滑动合并（RNSM），利用结构信息来提升合并效率。我们进一步提出了合并顺序选择（MOS），通过消除冗余操作来最小化多个索引合并的总成本。实验……
tldr: 本文提出了利用图结构信息的反向邻居滑动合并（RNSM）方法以及通过消除冗余操作最小化总合并成本的合并顺序选择（MOS）方法，实现了多个邻近图索引的高效合并。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Reverse Neighbor Sliding Merge (RNSM), which exploits graph structural information, and Merge Order Selection (MOS), which minimizes total merge cost by eliminating redundant operations, to achieve efficient merging of multiple proximity graph indexes.
